questions.question:
Financial data of four companies (sales in ₹ lakh)

Company | Sales | COGS (% of sales) | Operating expenses (% of sales) | Tax (% of profit before tax)
Alfa | 800 | 50% | 10% | 30%
Beta | 600 | 60% | 5% | 25%
Gamma | 1000 | 40% | 15% | 20%
Delta | 500 | 70% | 10% | 30%

What is the gross profit of Alfa (₹ lakh)?
questions.explanation: Alfa's COGS is 50% of 800, so gross profit = 800 − 400 = 400. The answer is 400.
